QF.id: AIFM CIII Fund Monitoring Reporting and Exit_23

question.text: Under Regulation 20, to whom must the Compliance Officer independently report deviations, and within what time?

answer.text: SEBI, independently, for deviations (within 7 working days)

explanation.text: The Logic: Regulation 20 requires the Compliance Officer to independently report any deviation to SEBI forthwith and within 7 working days. The duty is an independent deviation-reporting obligation rather than a functional/employment reporting line. The Trap: Options A (Sponsor's group CFO), B (prime broker) and D (lead investor) are plausible org-chart distractors but none holds the independent SEBI-reporting right on deviations under Regulation 20. Note: Stem reworded to ask about independent SEBI deviation reporting (not a functional reporting line); unsupported framing removed.
